verification_status.verification_notes: Study in Romania page confirms the 2026-27 call (deadline 31 Mar 2026, results about 15 Jul 2026), Romanian-taught bachelor's and master's, and excluded fields. The opening date (16 Feb 2026), minimum grade of 7 (Romanian scale) and benefits (tuition, dorm, medical, transport, 925 lei a month) come from Romanian embassy pages seen only in search results; those pages returned 503 when fetched. tuition_coverage left null for that reason. The 2022 tweet said there are no travel costs; not confirmed. Funding type 'Fully Funded' follows the embassy summaries and needs a human check.
